comments.how: written for the six holiday videos

voice.text: The freezer snowman one made my kid laugh so hard. Please do more small magic in small rooms.
Gravy heist was perfect, but it was way too dark at the start. I couldn't see the mouse.
I want a whole series of the cat judging sweaters. The slow blink at the snowflake sweater. Chef's kiss.
The gift robot felt like an ad for the wrapping paper. Less product, more robot being bad at it.
The robin in the lights was so cozy. Can you do one where it moves into the fridge light next?
Scarecrow sweater made me tear up. The ending where it finally gets warm. More endings like that.
The captions covered the snowman's face for the whole second half. Move the text, or drop it.
Idea for you: the doorbell that only rings for snowmen. Filmed like a security camera.
